responsibility: Implements shared code-generation utilities and runtime-variable support used across many COBOL statement lowerings. It owns the front end’s global tree decls for exception state, call metadata, arithmetic helper arrays, and debugger-support nop variables; computes refer offsets and sizes including OCCURS DEPENDING ON and refmod cases; builds qualified data locations and helper arrays; and provides assorted numeric, data-address, exception, and timing utilities needed by genapi.cc and genmath.cc.
same_name_distinction: Implements the shared codegen utility state and helper routines declared in genutil.h, including definitions of the global tree decl variables and the concrete refer/offset/size, exception, and helper-array logic used by generators.
